ch_eye_scope.name: Scope Eye
ch_eye_scope.desc: A salvaged military optic. Finds the gap in any armour and the tremble in any hand.

ch_eye_heat.name: Ember Eyes
ch_eye_heat.desc: Mender-built thermal lenses. Bodies glow through thin walls; the world looks like a fever.

ch_eye_concern.name: Clearsight
ch_eye_concern.desc: Concern optics: perfect vision, face recognition, a quiet overlay of names and debts.

ch_neural_reflex.name: Kick Wiring
ch_neural_reflex.desc: Reflex boosters spliced into the spine’s top. Time stutters; you do not.

ch_neural_link.name: Gridjack
ch_neural_link.desc: A neural port and interface. In a city, the grid answers when you think at it.

ch_arm_breaker.name: Breaker Arm
ch_arm_breaker.desc: A hydraulic forearm. Doors, plating and bones are all just resistance.

ch_arm_steady.name: Gyro Hand
ch_arm_steady.desc: A stabilised pre-Burn surgical hand. Never shakes, never tires.

ch_legs_spring.name: Spring Legs
ch_legs_spring.desc: Sprung shins and reinforced knees. Rooftops are just another floor.

ch_legs_strider.name: Strider Frames
ch_legs_strider.desc: Concern carbon frames. Carry a mule’s load; walk all day.

ch_spine_load.name: Loadbearer Spine
ch_spine_load.desc: A braced spine from a dead labour gang. Heavy weapons stop being heavy.

ch_skin_plate.name: Subdermal Plate
ch_skin_plate.desc: Ceramic scales under the skin. Shows at the knuckles and collarbones.

ch_skin_weave.name: Silkweave
ch_skin_weave.desc: Concern dermal mesh: stops a knife, passes for perfect skin.

ch_org_lungs.name: Filter Lungs
ch_org_lungs.desc: Scrubber lungs. Dust storms, spores and gas are just weather.

ch_org_heart.name: Second Heart
ch_org_heart.desc: A backup pump that kicks when the first one stops. Once.

ch_org_voice.name: Echo Larynx
ch_org_voice.desc: A voice box that can wear anyone’s voice it has heard long enough.
